direct_claims: This chart compares global biomass, measured in tonnes of carbon, with the abundance, measured as number of individuals, across different taxonomic groups.

Both axes are plotted on logarithmic scales.
The chart includes labeled groups such as plants, bacteria, archaea, fungi, protists, viruses, arthropods (marine), nematodes, annelids, cnidarians, fish, humans, and wild birds.
The source line cites Bar-On, Phillips, and Milo (2018) on the biomass distribution on Earth, and the graphic is branded by Our World in Data.
